title: The panel passes axe with no critical violation and its two small texts meet 4.5:1 in both themes
requirement: In the Project state panel the header's right-column toggle must name an element that exists while the drawer is closed (no axe critical), and the two small texts that failed contrast — the open status chip and the header badge — must read at 4.5:1 or better on the light and the dark theme, without removing the relationship the toggle declares.
steps: Run node .tmp/panel-ux/run.mjs verify: it mounts the production plugins/project-state-panel/client.js over the workspace's 484-task index in Chrome and scans the whole panel with the pinned axe-core.
Print the axe impact counts and the id of every violation.
Measure the WCAG contrast of .ps-status.open and .ps-ro against the background each is painted on, once under the light tokens and once with body[data-ds-dark-theme].
Confirm #ps-rail exists and is hidden while no card is open, opens with a task click, and hides again on Escape.
Negative control: the same run over the pre-fix bundle (.tmp/panel-ux/client.axe-before.js) reports 1 critical aria-valid-attr-value, 2 color-contrast nodes, 1.8:1 and 4.33:1, and exits 1.
expected: axe reports 0 violations, 0 critical; .ps-status.open is 5.51:1 (light) and 11.53:1 (dark); .ps-ro is 5.38:1 (light) and 7.88:1 (dark); #ps-rail is present and hidden while closed, shows the drawer on a task click and hides on Escape.
failsWhen: The header toggle names an element that is absent while the drawer is closed (axe aria-valid-attr-value, critical), the status chip or the header badge falls below 4.5:1 on either theme, or the always-present rail element stops opening the drawer.
trigger: A user opens the panel with no card open — the header's right-column toggle is on screen and its aria-controls points at the closed column — then opens and closes a task card; axe scans that first screen.
oracle: WCAG 2.1 AA 1.4.3 (4.5:1 for text under 18.66 px bold / 24 px) and the axe rule aria-valid-attr-value: every IDREF must resolve to an element in the document.
realism: Production-shaped data (the workspace's own state/views/index.json, 484 tasks) rendered by the production bundle; axe-core 4.14.0 and Chrome as installed, both themes from the shell's own token CSS.
